description: This file defines the ContactsListActivity class, which is a FragmentActivity managing the display of a contacts list and contact details within an Android application. It handles search intents, manages two-pane layouts for larger screens, and responds to user interactions such as contact selection and clearing selections.

classes.name: ContactsListActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for displaying and managing contacts list and contact details, handling search intents, and supporting larger screen layouts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for search action, manages layout resources, and sets up fragments.

methods.name: onContactSelected
methods.description: Callback when a contact is selected; updates the detail fragment or starts a new detail activity.

methods.name: onSelectionCleared
methods.description: Callback when a contact selection is cleared; resets the detail fragment.

methods.name: onSearchRequested
methods.description: Prevents initiating a new search if the activity is already displaying search results.
